summary_en: Demonstrates a genetic-algorithm-designed, tomographically 3D-printed phase-type acoustic meta-lens for far-field super-resolution pulse-echo ultrasound imaging. Experiments achieve a 0.42-lambda lateral focusing FWHM beyond 20 wavelengths and a 0.46-lambda pulse-echo imaging FWHM, compared with 0.80 lambda for a conventional Fresnel lens, making the work directly relevant to high-resolution computational acoustic imaging and nondestructive testing.

summary_en: Introduces GF-NUTS, an adaptive grid-free Bayesian method for three-dimensional acoustic source imaging. The approach uses equivalent-source physics, No-U-Turn sampling of continuous source positions, fixed-point strength/noise estimation, and a potential-energy-based Bayesian Information Criterion for source enumeration; simulations and nose-landing-gear experiments demonstrate improved localization and convergence over conventional grid-based and grid-free alternatives.

summary_en: Presents Sonar-CycleGAN, a forward-looking-sonar image-synthesis framework that incorporates six-degree-of-freedom AUV motion trajectories and a shallow-water noise-distribution model into CycleGAN. The method improves KID/FID-style realism metrics and yields measurable downstream object-detection gains when synthetic sonar imagery augments real training data, making it relevant as a computational sonar-imaging/data-generation paper but less central than direct image-formation work.
